mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, sponsor_membership_id, operator_ref, target_issuer, target_subject, member_kind, token_hash, expires_at, membership_valid_to, state, version, accepted_membership_id, accepted_generation, accepted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_governance.invitation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.invitation(id, tenant_id, sponsor_membership_id, operator_ref, target_issuer, target_subject, member_kind, token_hash, expires_at, membership_valid_to, state, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sponsorMembershipId}, #{operatorRef}, #{targetIssuer}, #{targetSubject}, #{memberKind}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{membershipValidTo}, #{state}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.invitation SET state = 'ACCEPTED', version = version + 1, accepted_membership_id = #{memberId}, accepted_generation = #{generation}, accepted_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
UPDATE auth_governance.invitation SET state = 'REVOKED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.tenant_id, m.principal_id, m.member_kind, m.status, m.generation, m.version, m.valid_from, m.valid_to, m.sponsor_membership_id FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal p ON p.id = m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.member_kind = 'EMPLOYEE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.kind = 'HUMAN' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > clock_timestamp()) FOR SHARE OF m, p, t
SELECT id, kind, status, version FROM auth_governance.principal WHERE id = #{id} AND kind = 'HUMAN' AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR SHARE

SELECT id, tenant_id, principal_id, member_kind, status, generation, version, valid_from, valid_to, sponsor_membership_id FROM auth_governance.membership WHERE principal_id = #{principalId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.membership SET status = 'ACTIVE', generation = generation + 1, version = version + 1, valid_from = #{member.validFrom}, valid_to = #{member.validTo}, sponsor_membership_id = #{member.sponsorMembershipId}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{member.id} AND tenant_id = #{member.tenantId} AND principal_id = #{member.principalId} AND version = #{member.version} - 1 AND generation = #{member.generation} - 1 AND status = 'LEFT' AND member_kind = #{member.memberKind} AND member_kind IN ('PARTNER', 'GUEST')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.invitation_audit_detail(audit_event_id, invitation_id, reason, previous_state, resulting_state, previous_version) VALUES (#{auditId}, #{invitationId}, #{reason}, #{before}, #{after}, #{previousVersion})
